faqs.q: How does the copy trading work?
faqs.a: Our AI analyzes trader performance and automatically copies their trades proportionally to your account size. You set risk parameters and the bot handles the execution.
We support Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, and other major exchanges. More are added based on user demand and market stability.
Results vary based on the traders you copy and market conditions. Our average users see 15-30% monthly returns, but past performance doesn't guarantee future results.
Yes, we use API keys with read-only access for portfolio tracking and trade execution only. We never have access to your funds or withdrawal permissions.

faqs.q: Can I control my own trades?
faqs.a: Absolutely! You can override any copied trade, set your own parameters, or pause copying at any time through our dashboard.
Full access to all features, unlimited trader copying, 24/7 support, API access, and all future updates. 30-day money-back guarantee included.
